title: An L-Stable Sequential Two-Stage Fourth-Order Method with ADER Trajectory Derivatives for Stiff Transport--Relaxation Systems
summary: A fully implicit two-stage fourth-order two-derivative time discretization was introduced previously as a temporal method. This paper closes that sequential integrator for stiff transport--relaxation equations by pairing a conservative finite-volume residual $\mathcal L_h$ with its discrete trajectory derivative $\mathcal G_h^{\rm tr}=D\mathcal L_h\,\mathcal L_h$.
